name: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon (21.1 km, plus 10 km and 5 km options) set for June 13, 2027 at Botumvatey Pagoda Park in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
ai_summary: The Phnom Penh International Half Marathon is scheduled for June 13, 2027, at Botumvatey Pagoda Park in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. The event offers three distance options: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race, catering to a range of runner abilities. The organizer is not explicitly named but is noted to be the same organizer behind the E19 and E68 events.
pros: Four-hour limit on the 21 km: every timed finisher in 2026 came in under it
Water every 2 km, with a new 2026 course along the riverside and through Koh Pich and Koh Norea
A field of about 5,000 with 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km options
Modest fees, from US$28 for Cambodians and US$45 for foreign runners in 2026
cons: Roads are not fully closed; runners reported traffic and motorbikes on the course
Finisher medals did not arrive until weeks after the 2026 race
Routes for different distances split without clear signs, and one runner took a wrong turn
Entries cannot be refunded, transferred or carried over to the next year

faqs.question: When is the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on June 13, 2027. It will be held at Botumvatey Pagoda Park in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, giving participants a specific date to plan their training and travel around well in advance of the event.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from?
faqs.answer: Participants can select from three distance options: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to take part in the event at Botumvatey Pagoda Park.

faqs.question: Who is organizing the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The specific organizer for this event is not explicitly stated in available information. However, it is noted that the same organizer is responsible for the E19 and E68 events, suggesting some continuity in event management, though further details have not been confirmed.
